name: LNG & Future Fuels
tagline: LNG · METHANOL · AMMONIA · CARBON CAPTURE · rDME
headline: Dry couplings and transfer equipment for LNG and future fuels.
description: LNG bunkering, methanol and ammonia transfer, liquid CO₂ for carbon capture, and rDME blended into LPG all need the same thing: a connection that closes before it separates and lets go safely when a vessel or vehicle moves. We supply MannTek dry cryogenic couplings, breakaways, powered emergency release couplings and the hose-string equipment around them, as an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE.
seoTitle: LNG & Future Fuel Transfer Couplings — MannTek
seoDescription: MannTek dry cryogenic couplings (ISO 21593, -196 °C), breakaways, PERC emergency release and bunkering hose equipment for LNG, methanol, ammonia and CO₂.

deliveryAreas.title: Dry cryogenic couplings
deliveryAreas.description: MannTek DCC tank and hose units to ISO/TS 18683 or ISO 21593, for LNG and liquid gases down to -196 °C.

deliveryAreas.title: Cryogenic breakaway couplings
deliveryAreas.description: CBC breaking-bolt and cable-release types. Both halves close as the line separates under excess pull.

deliveryAreas.title: Powered Emergency Release Coupling
deliveryAreas.description: PERC with three ways of release, including on an ESD signal and by manual override, run by a SIL2-assessed PLC.

deliveryAreas.title: Vessel Separation Device
deliveryAreas.description: Three wires of different length: an alarm, then ESD 1 to stop pumps and close valves, then ESD 2 to release the PERC.

deliveryAreas.title: Dry gas and rDME couplings
deliveryAreas.description: DGC for LPG and other gases, and the rDME coupling for renewable DME blended into LPG, with anticlockwise connection.

deliveryAreas.title: Dry disconnect and Evotek couplings
deliveryAreas.description: MannTek lists the DDC among its methanol solutions; the DEC suits chemical and pharmaceutical transfer.

deliveryAreas.title: Safety breakaway couplings
deliveryAreas.description: SBC breaking-bolt (industrial or marine) and SBC-C cable release, part of MannTek's ammonia and methanol solutions.

deliveryAreas.title: Transfer hose
deliveryAreas.description: Composite or stainless steel transfer hose from MannTek, 1" to 10", 10 to 25 bar working pressure.

deliveryAreas.title: Saddles, buns, lifting and covers
deliveryAreas.description: Single or double hose saddles hold the bend radius on both vessels; hose buns, lifting gear and Kevlar-reinforced covers protect the hose.

deliveryAreas.title: Fall arrest and Twin PERC
deliveryAreas.description: A friction fall arrest lowers the hose at a steady rate after the PERC releases; Twin PERC releases the purge line too.

deliveryAreas.title: Purge lines, insulation flanges, spool pieces
deliveryAreas.description: Nitrogen purge lines through a spool piece, insulation flanges to break electrical continuity, Y-pieces and reducers.

deliveryAreas.title: Heated parking device
deliveryAreas.description: Defrosts and dries the DCC hose unit after an LNG transfer, so it is ready to use again within minutes.

supportBlock.headline: The coupling, the breakaway and the hose string, quoted together.
supportBlock.description: Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek equipment direct from MannTek in Sweden. Send the medium, line size, transfer layout and the standard your terminal or vessel specifies, and we put the package together with the quotation.
